facts.fact: MMLP states that Zambia enacted the Data Protection Act, 2021 in 2021.
The Data Protection Commissioner, the Act's regulatory authority, set an enforcement roadmap on 31 October 2023 and revised it by April 2024, according to MMLP.

ZMB.note: The roadmap's registration, training and audits are scheduled from May 2024 and are not yet activity.
